reviewTitle: Battery low message ridiculously too loud
reviewDescription: Having the "battery low" signal at full volume has got to be the stupidest idea in the history of earbuds. We control the volume from our device. Many of us use these products for sleep. Battery low at full volume is annoying and ridiculous. Whoever's idea that was should be fired for waking up countless users who sleep to music. For that reason alone, I cannot recommend this product.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on November 15, 2026

reviewDescription: Had these headphones for over a year now, and can I am very impressed. I used Raycon prior but had personal issues such as getting them wet due to forgetting them in the washing machine a few times, work related getting them wet and in very hot climates. Very rugged and even when I drop the case a lot as I do with my earbuds of the past they hold up great. The other day I left for work early and returned home after working 32 hours (Fire Fighter 24 & part time gig). It rained prior very hard and got to 26° at my house. Picked them out of my submerged mud where a neighbor ran them over and popped them in. No issues still and charging port still works! Would highly recommend
